responsibility: First-launch flow with persisted PIPL consent as a hard gate, an optional user-initiated PhotoKit connection, language selection and local-model loading. Notification, location and HealthKit are excluded from launch and remain contextual Awakening actions.

inputs.privacySummary: PIPL privacy policy summary with purpose/method/kind/retention/local-processing statement (US-PRV-008 AC-2)
inputs.permissionSteps: After consent persistence succeeds, offer Connect Photos or Not Now. Only Connect Photos may request PhotoKit .readWrite; Not Now performs no system call. Notification, location and HealthKit never appear in onboarding.
inputs.icloudDownloadPrompt: US-SRC-001 AC-6 first photo permission download-and-keep-original hint with Open Settings button
inputs.languages: zh-Hans | en-US picker (US-SYN-001 AC-2); traditional/other mapped to zh-Hans with one-time hint
inputs.modelLoadProgress: Determinate progress for first model load (§15.6); driven by ModelLoaderActor.overallStatus (3F.3), no fixture fallback in production

outputs.visibleContent: welcome -> privacy consent -> consent persisting/error -> optional Connect Photos -> language -> model loading. Protected permission UI is unreachable until consent persistence succeeds.
outputs.interactionTargets: onboarding-start, onboarding-privacy-agree, onboarding-privacy-decline, onboarding-permission-allow, onboarding-permission-deny, onboarding-permission-skip, onboarding-open-settings, onboarding-language-zh, onboarding-language-en, onboarding-begin-load, onboarding-declined-close, onboarding-retry-consent
outputs.accessibilityTree: Step indicator announced; privacy summary scrollable; agree/decline visible at the same hierarchy with neither preselected; optional photo connection and skip are explicit; language picker has a selected checkmark

systemContainer: fullScreenCover + TabView (step pages) + Form (language picker) + ProgressView (model loading)
fallbackConditions: Consent persistence failure remains on a retryable consent error and issues zero protected-data requests
Not Now skips Photos with zero PhotoKit calls; denied/restricted recovery is user-initiated
Opening or re-entering onboarding never automatically requests a system permission
